headline: Emory & Henry and Catawba set up a rematch
dek: Emory & Henry beat Coker and Catawba beat Anderson on Friday, and the table's leading sides meet again on Sunday. Their September meeting at Catawba ended goalless; Emory & Henry go in a point clear and still without a defeat.
displaced_by: news: both leaders won on Friday and meet again on Sunday

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Emory & Henry have scored 26 and conceded six: the side top of the table has got there by keeping goals out, not by scoring them.

wire.line: Emory & Henry go into Sunday's meeting with Catawba as the conference's only unbeaten side.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and the rest Emory & Henry's, the latest their home match with Palm Beach Atlantic in September.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Emory & Henry's win over Coker on Friday was their ninth of the season; they have drawn three and lost none.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Catawba's win over Anderson on Friday was their fourteenth of the season, against two draws and one defeat.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Anderson's defeat by Catawba on Friday was their third of the season, against ten wins and four draws.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Coker's defeat by Emory & Henry on Friday was their sixth of the season, beside seven wins and two draws.

last_match.line: Emory & Henry remain unbeaten; Coker have now lost to them home and away.

next_match.line: Catawba's only defeat this season came at home to Coker in October.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
